description: React component implementing an anomaly detection page with dataset upload, feature selection, algorithm configuration, and results display.

methods.name: formatPct
methods.description: Formats a number as a percentage string, or '—' if not finite.

methods.name: formatNum
methods.description: Formats a number with fixed decimal places, or '—' if not finite.

methods.name: pickDefaultSelectedColumns
methods.description: Selects up to 12 numeric columns as default feature set.

methods.name: summarizeRowPreview
methods.description: Creates a preview object of a row with selected columns, limited to first 6 columns.

methods.name: loadDefaultDataset
methods.description: Loads a bundled dataset from a public asset for initial analysis.

methods.name: loadUploadedFile
methods.description: Parses and loads a user-uploaded Excel file for analysis.

methods.name: runDetection
methods.description: Performs anomaly detection on the selected dataset and features, updates results, and logs the run.
